messages.subject: shiny tabPanels within shiny dashboard tabItems
parts:
I have set up a shiny dashboard page with the following code:

dashboardBody(tabItems(
    tabItem("CellCODE",
            column(10,plotOutput("SPV"))
    ),
    
    tabItem("Limma-output",
             column(12,plotOutput("volcano1"))
             )
  )
  )
  )
All of the above works fine however, within the tabItem "Limma-output" there are 2 more plots that I would like to render to the page- "volcano2" and "volcano3". Only the thing is I would like for them to be in separate tabs within the tabItems.... I have attempted this as follows:

tabItem("Limma-output",
            tabsetPanel(tabPanel("1",
            plotOutput("volcano3")),
            tabPanel("2", plotOutput("volcano2"))
            tabPanel("3", plotOutput("volcano3")))
         )
While everything seems to work for some reason none of the plots actually show- not even the "CellCODE" one which is completely impartial of the tabItem that contains the tabPanels....



So can anyone tell how I might go about setting up a "tabs within tabs" layout within shiny??
